market_overview: Across the board, sentiment remains mixed with pockets of bullish bias in AI, Bitcoin and the U.S. dollar, while rates, inflation, oil, equities, gold and broader markets show neutral to mixed outlooks. Evidence shows central‑bank policy and inflation data dominate rates and inflation coverage, whereas geopolitical risk and supply concerns feature in oil and equities. Divergent votes—from bullish to bearish—reflect the high level of conflicting coverage, limiting consensus strength despite high confidence scores. Market moves such as the yen’s reversal and the 10‑year yield rise are mirrored by mixed readings in related topics, underscoring a cautious environment.
